item.title: Nyuunyuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ange
  • 発売日: 2001-10-12
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: にゅうにゅう
  • 英語名: Nyuunyuu

あらすじ

One day, Shoji Oba asks the woman posing as his sister who she really is. Her name is Erika Chichiski. She is a boob alien from the planet Boob. A meteorite hit her planet and broke it into pieces. She escaped and roamed about space before she came to earth. Shoji doesn’t really believe her story, but he gives in to the temptation of having a big breasted chic around and decides to let her stay. However, Shoji soon regrets his decision

item.title: Eternity
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ange
  • 発売日: 2001-06-29
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: エターニティ
  • 英語名: Eternity

あらすじ

One day, Tatsuhiko finds a strange glowing stone in an antique shop. He gets the feeling that somebody is hailing him as he holds the stone. He decides to look for the origin of the stone. On his way to the mountain village where the stone was found, Tatsuhiko loses his way. A girl called Yuka saves Tatsuhiko and tells him about old folklore of the village. There is a story of a snow woman who was caught and sealed somewhere in the village. Later on, Tatsuhiko, Yuka, and her friend Nagi look for clues about the stone, but they find nothing. In the night, Tatsuhiko is called by the stone again and brought into an old storehouse.

  • 日本語名: くるくる天気は花丸模様
  • 英語名: Kurukuru Tenki wa Hanamaru Moyou

あらすじ

Located in the city of Abel Town, a small inn called Moku More Nittei serves mainly the local Sevito people. Very few humans ever come this way. Once in a while, the explorer Lime will show up with the elf Nashan. One day, a girl named Artia shows up with a treasure map. She claims there is buried treasure beneath one of the trees near the inn. Her announcement causes frenzied digging. These reckless attempts are finally stopped, but the atmosphere remains electric. On top of this, Lime shows up with the female swordsman, Gina, hot on his trail. The excitement and commotion grow…

item.title: Life ~Omoide no Hashi ni~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ange
  • 発売日: 2000-11-10
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Life ～思い出の橋に～
  • 英語名: Life Omoide no Hashi ni

あらすじ

This bridge has seen a lot of stories during its lifetime. Here are memories of some of its regulars - lovers, prostitutes, travelers, soldiers.

[From vndbreview]

This novel is an omnibus consisting of 6 stories, with one choice option per episode and single or multiple ending. As the protagonist you take the role of a spirit who lives on a bridge and observes people passing on it without being seen. This “bridge” bears the beginning and end of different encounters life scenarios, farewells, promises, passing, and recollections. In the central scenario, you follow the growth and life path of a girl named Charles from the perspective of the spirit on the bridge.

あらすじ

Max and his wife worked at police. But 10 years ago his wife got killed during a police operation and Max has led repeated, alcohol-dependent life ever since. One winter day at the dusk he and general store owner Koharu find a mysterious girl Mil in metal collar and shackles. Koharu persuades Max to give the girl shelter just for one night and Mil stays to live with him. Max falls in love with Mill and decides to protect her instead of his deceased wife that he could not protect.

The hero of this game (default name Ryouta) is a typical hentai protagonist: a male teenager who is interested only in sex. One day, Ryouta finds a cute black bunny and brings it home; the next morning, the bunny turns into a sexy black-haired girl! Needless to say the activities the two perform during the course of the game do not include playing chess or discussing philosophy. But Ryouta is not satisfied with the “bunny girl” alone, what with all those cute female schoolmates around him…

あらすじ

Nikki, the hero of the game, is a cybernetically enhanced young man from the future. His “home time” is the beginning of 22th century; his home town is the international megalopolis Shinjuku City, part of the old Tokyo. Humanity prospers, living in pleasure, relying on incredible scientific achievements. One of them is the time machine. Nikki finds out than four young, attractive school girls from 1994 got involved into some sort of trouble. Using his time machine, Nikki ventures into the past, determined to save them… and expecting a lot of… err… gratitude in return!
